entries.title: Your Claude allowance keeps updating after Claude Code renews its sign-in
entries.body: On a Mac, after you chose Always Allow, your Claude allowance could stop updating every few hours with a note that macOS did not allow reading your sign-in, until you pressed Refresh and approved the macOS password window again. Infinitary now keeps reading it in the background each time Claude Code renews its sign-in.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the allowance simply keeps updating instead of going stale.
